# Charts Props

## WaterfallChart

`packages/core/src/types/chart-visualization.ts` · `WaterfallChartProps` · 3/11 compact props · [Complete props](#remaining-props-complete-public-api)

| Prop      | Type                   | Default | Notes                                          |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `data`    | `WaterfallDatum[]`     | `-`     | -                                              |
| `locale?` | `Partial<TigerLocale>` | `-`     | Locale object merged on top of ConfigProvider. |
| `width?`  | `number`               | `480`   | Chart width.                                   |

### Remaining props (complete public API)

- `height?`: `number`; default `-`. -
- `padding?`: `ChartPadding`; default `24`. Chart padding without extra axis spacing.
- `responsive?`: `boolean`; default `true`. Whether the SVG should observe its container and resize responsively.
- `colors?`: `{ increase?: string; decrease?: string; total?: string }`; default `-`. -
- `title?`: `string`; default `-`. Accessible title for the SVG
- `desc?`: `string`; default `-`. Accessible description for the SVG
- `className?`: `string`; default `-`. Additional CSS classes
- `labels?`: `Partial<TigerLocaleChart>`; default `-`. Chart copy overlay. Dedicated aria props win, then `labels`, then `locale.chart`.
